text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Hey, Ruby, have you seen my tail brush anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, at least not in our room.
Have you misplaced it?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I haven't been able to find it since last night...
Thanks, I'll look around some more.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wasssuuup, it's the lady herself!
Wait, seeing you here is crazy rare, isn't it?!
Usually you hit the bath and then GO straight to your room, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The brush...
No, it is nothing. Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, Milady~~!!
Hold up a sec~~! What about the brush?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Looked like you were searching for something...
Did you lose it or what?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's time for me to step in!
I gotta get Ruby totally hyped up!
Let's gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san. Is the brush you are looking for difficult to procure?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No.
I wouldn't say so.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(...The product name she gave me... found it.
Indeed, it is quite common and inexpensive...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Brushing is essential for tail care.
Neglecting it makes balancing with the tail difficult, which will impact her running.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...If it remains lost, she will be forced to neglect that care for an extended period.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (As a member of my lineage, what I ought to do right now is—)
One morning, I spotted Daiichi Ruby and KS Miracle on their way to school.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Um, Miracle-san—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Milady!! Chori~~~ss☆
Hey hey, is this the brush you were looking for?!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Brush...?
...Um, sorry. May I take a look?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's my brush...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I've been looking everywhere for it!
I'm so glad it's been found...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: When I was discharged from the hospital that looked after me, the kid patients pooled their pocket money together to buy it for me, so...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! That's so wholesome!!
Totally worth searching for, majorly!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh?! So that means it wasn't Milady's lost item after all?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I was merely concerned about it.
Thank you very much for your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha... Well, Miracle is happy-peep, Milady is happy-peep! Which means I'm happy-peep too!!
All's well that ends well! Later then~☆

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, you were searching for it too, weren't you?
Thank you.
Also, what were you about to say earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It is nothing of significance.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Really?
Please don't hold back, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, it is nothing important.
Only...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I happen to have purchased a brush.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it was entirely the result of my jumping ahead, so there is no need for you to worry.
I shall dispose of it myself.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ruby.
...It might be selfish of me, but could I have that one too?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...!
I'll cherish and use this one forever, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
